fixed.summary: ArenaScoreboard, ArenaLobby, ArenaDraft, ArenaReady, ArenaRoster, ArenaRoundHud, ArenaSpectator, ArenaVersus and ArenaVote draw their rows and plates on opaque theme grounds and pack slots in those grounds' inks, so their text reads over a bright scene in every pack (the scoreboard's names, the lobby's Open slot and the draft's Lock in).
